texts.facts: Based on the said report, a show cause notice comes to be issued against the petitioner alleging violation of the provisions of the Act and the Rules.
texts.arguments: He would contend that the very registration of crime against the petitioner invoking Section 29 of the Act and placing it before the learned Magistrate under Section 200 of the Cr.P.C. is on the face of it illegal.
